svg.title: Every library and transport, by client connections
svg.desc: Same five calls, same Kestrel, clients on the server's 8 cores, 2026-09-23. TCP and gRPC keep 256 requests in flight per connection; HTTP clients await one POST at a time (1 or 100 RPCs). 5 runs of 2 s per point; whiskers span the runs. Data revision eacac12e8d55.
